# Hotel Prabhupada, Puri

> Hotel Prabhupada is a sea-facing, pet-friendly hotel on New Marine Drive near the lighthouse in Puri, Odisha, India. Accommodation includes front sea-view rooms, side sea-view balcony rooms and non-sea-view rooms for families and other travellers.

Official website: https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-03.

Address: New Marine Drive Road, Near Light House, Puri, Odisha 752001, India.
Reservations: +91 9583002952 / +91 9583002951; reservation@hotelprabhupada.com.

Room views and balconies depend on the category booked. Rates, availability, meal inclusions, pet acceptance and service charges require confirmation for the travel dates. Use current hotel pages and booking terms when they differ from this summary.

- [Rooms and suites](https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/rooms): Six categories with their views, furnishings and accessibility notes.
- [Amenities](https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/amenities): Guest services, Wi-Fi, air conditioning and limited free parking.
- [Contact](https://www.hotelprabhupada.com/contact): Reservation enquiries, telephone numbers, email and map.
